taxonomyNote: ADW places it in Charadriiformes, family Pteroclididae; NatureServe says the relationships of Pteroclididae are unclear (Charadriiformes vs Columbiformes; AOU 1998 incertae sedis). Order and family here follow ADW; not resolved. Field marks not sourced.
behavior: Powerful flyer adapted to desert; on Hawaii Island flies mauka to makai to collect water
Carries water to the nest in absorbent breast feathers for young to drink
range: Introduced to Hawaii Island by the Nevada game department as a trial for possible import to Nevada. NatureServe records it in Hawaii.
